author: chickenwim
body:
(I first of all want to note my name is just a practical joke)
My IGN was BluntHead_69 since about April, before I even started this server, and it still is.
I was banned for "fly hacking", although I think it was a mistake. Coincidentally _Poseidon_, the person who banned me, was saying on chat about another guy that had fly hacks. A few seconds after he said that I was banned.
I want to be unbanned because I was mistakenly banned and definitely want to go back to Avicus.

Thanks if you took the time to read and consider this; I really want to go back to Nebula!  (or Avicus).
